# Two extraordinary executions

> A Daily Star analysis of 665 Saudi government execution statements between January 2024 and 20 October 2026 reveals that the execution of Nazrul and Sweety was extremely unusual.

Published by The Daily Star (Dhaka, Bangladesh) on 29 October 2026.
Reporting: Abdullah Hel Bubun, Tarek Hosen and Keero Adnan Ahmed. Data collection: Mir Rownak.
Planning & design: Abdullah Hel Bubun. Development: Mir Rownak and Abdullah Hel Bubun.

## Story

- [Two extraordinary executions](https://campaign.thedailystar.net/saudi-execution/): the full article with its charts, and the list of the 887 people named in Saudi Interior Ministry press statements, January 2024 – 20 October 2026.

## Sections

- Confusions over allegations
- Judge’s discretion
- Saudi’s ‘war on drugs’
- Killing foreign nationals
- Those who were executed

## Use

- Quote the article as written and credit The Daily Star with a link to the story.
- The names in the list were transliterated from Arabic into English with an AI model; spellings may differ from official records or from how families write them.
